display_name: ALU: XOR inversion and AND-mask zeroing
summary: Same Hack ALU function, different gate organisation: zeroing with an AND mask, conditional negation with XOR against the control bit, zero detection in a separate Zero16 chip. CPU unchanged.
changes: ALU.hdl: Mux16(x,0,zx) -> And16(x, NOT zx broadcast)
ALU.hdl: Not16+Mux16 negation -> Xor16Bit (16 XOR gates against nx/ny/no)
limitations: Removes 6 Mux16 and 3 Not16 parts but adds 48 one-bit Xor parts; whether this is smaller or faster in real hardware depends on the gate library and is not measured here.
